incidents.title: Checkout 5xx spike after v2.12 release
incidents.symptoms: 5xx error rate jumped from 0.01% to 15% immediately following deployment of v2.12.0. Logs showed NullPointerException in payment payload serialization.
incidents.root_cause: Deploy regression: unhandled null pointer in new discount validator code.
incidents.notes: Rollback succeeded within 4 minutes, restoring normal checkout conversions.

incidents.title: Search service memory leak and OOM crash-loop
incidents.symptoms: Search pods restarting every 40 minutes due to OOMKilled exit code 137. Heap graphs showed steady linear memory growth with zero leveling off.
incidents.root_cause: Query result cache unbounded retention key leak.
incidents.notes: Staggered rolling restart stabilized latency while engineering patched the cache TTL.

incidents.title: Primary payment provider timeout outage
incidents.symptoms: Orders service experiencing 504 Gateway Timeouts when calling payments-gateway. Outbound requests to primary payment partner failing with connection refused.
incidents.root_cause: External payment gateway provider major network outage.
incidents.notes: Failover to secondary warm provider restored 99.98% authorization rate.

incidents.title: Auth service intermittent latency degradation
incidents.symptoms: Intermittent token validation delays; logs showed sparse warnings without clear root cause.
incidents.root_cause: Database connection saturation on read replica.
incidents.notes: Ambiguous symptoms required DBA investigation to tune connection limits.

incidents.title: Inventory service breaking migration deploy failure
incidents.symptoms: Errors after v1.8 deploy due to schema change. Rollback was attempted but caused complete outage because old code expected deleted table.
incidents.root_cause: Destructive DB migration made code rollback unsafe.
incidents.notes: Emergency hotfix was required; rollback was rejected as dangerous.

incidents.title: API Gateway CPU spike under traffic burst
incidents.symptoms: Gateway CPU reached 98% during marketing campaign; latency increased across all endpoints.
incidents.root_cause: Excessive regex parsing in edge routing rules.
incidents.notes: Scaled out pod count and restarted overloaded instances.

incidents.title: User Profile service Redis cache disconnect
incidents.symptoms: Sudden increase in direct database load as cache hit ratio dropped to zero.
incidents.notes: Restarted connection pools to trigger Redis reconnect.

incidents.title: Shipping service downstream carrier API degradation
incidents.symptoms: Label generation timeouts when contacting primary shipping carrier API.
incidents.notes: Routed label generation requests to backup logistics partner.

incidents.title: Notification service worker pool thread exhaustion
incidents.symptoms: SMS queues backing up; worker thread pool completely stalled.
incidents.root_cause: Synchronous HTTP socket hang on unresponsive third-party SMS webhook.
incidents.notes: Rolling restart with socket timeouts forced queue drainage.

incidents.title: Orders service database lock contention
incidents.symptoms: Order creation latency p99 breached 8 seconds; row locks blocking inserts.
incidents.root_cause: Unindexed foreign key check during concurrent checkout transactions.
incidents.notes: On-call DBA killed long-running lock query and added concurrent index.

incidents.title: Search index corruption following node reboot
incidents.symptoms: Search results returning empty arrays for popular product queries.
incidents.notes: Failed over queries to standby search replica while primary rebuilt shards.

incidents.title: Checkout service cart validation bug in v2.10
incidents.symptoms: Immediate spike in 400 Bad Request on cart submit right after deployment.
incidents.root_cause: Deploy regression in frontend schema validation contracts.
incidents.notes: Rolled back to v2.9.4 within 5 minutes.

incidents.title: Analytics service memory leak on bulk batch ingestion
incidents.symptoms: OOM crash every evening at midnight during daily batch aggregation.
incidents.root_cause: Unbuffered dataframe aggregation holding entire day's logs in memory.
incidents.notes: Restarted analytics workers and chunked the batch jobs.

incidents.title: Database replica lag spike causing stale reads
incidents.symptoms: Users seeing outdated profile updates due to 45-second replication lag.
incidents.notes: Infrastructure team rerouted replication traffic to dedicated direct connect.

incidents.title: Payments gateway provider certificate expiration
incidents.symptoms: SSL handshake errors connecting to primary processor.
incidents.root_cause: Expired intermediate CA certificate on primary provider endpoint.
incidents.notes: Failed over to secondary processor until provider refreshed their certificates.
